summary: TCW Specialty Lending LLC filed Form 8-K to report a material definitive agreement — an Organizational and Offering Expense Reimbursement Agreement with its adviser, TCW Asset Management Company LLC. Under the agreement, the company will reimburse the adviser for organizational and offering expenses exceeding 10 basis points of aggregate commitments. This is a routine expense reimbursement arrangement for a BDC, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic event, or structural change is involved. The filing is a standard current report under Item 1.01 and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
